desc:
📚 Run and restore your own cosy library!

Sort returns, shelve books by genre and Dewey number, repair damaged books, help readers and earn money to rebuild every corner.
🏚️ Restore a derelict library
🛒 Load your trolley and shelve armfuls of books
🛋️ Decorate cosy reading spaces
👥 Work with friends at Central Library
🪪 Turn regular readers into named library members
🐈 Meet Cookie, your library cat

Shelf Life is a relaxed library tycoon and cozy management game with no timers and nobody shouting. Play at your own pace, then close for the day and continue building tomorrow.
